description: Apply an approved setup plan. First upload the plan's media (get_setup_run lists what is pending under media.pending): from the site's repository run `npx -y @mapled/cli media upload --run <runId>` — it uploads every file and public address the plan names (and `npx -y @mapled/cli tool apply_setup_plan` does it by itself) — or call upload_media with the runId for each public address. Mapled refuses to apply while media is missing. Then Mapled creates the collections, fields and records in one go and returns what was created (keys, counts) plus warnings for records it had to skip. Then wire the site (get_connection, configure_revalidation), write MAPLED.md (get_mapled_md), finish with report_setup and refresh MAPLED.md once more.

skipMissingMedia.description: Apply although some of the plan's media isn't uploaded: those image and file fields stay empty. Only after an upload failed for good.

name: apply_setup_plan
